summary: Implemented the decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper (standard library only). Exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, and test_seg_no_labels, each using a TemporaryDirectory context. Nothing was run: tests, black, and flake8 were not executed per instructions. Measured line lengths are at most 120 in the three Python files. No commit was made. Choices beyond the spec: missing image/label fields are skipped; a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; a non-object top-level JSON raises ValueError as a missing key.
